new_findings.text: art-anim-audio-feel/rig-is-19-nodes (UPHELD) says the rig 'keys 19 nodes per pose in the stance sets (20 in the human set)'. The human set does not key 20 per pose. Census over all 158 <anim> rows in the human blob reference/extracted/bindata/108_1t4635s0.bin, counting <n> records per <f> frame: the per-anim maximum is 20 in only 2 anims, 19 in 130, 18 in 10, 17 in 13 and 13 in 3. Worse for a fixed-rig renderer, 44 of the 158 anims have a per-frame node count that VARIES within the clip, and some frames carry ZERO <n> records at all (heavyhorizontalslash_partc, balancedhorizontalslash_partc, balancedjumpslash_parta, sheathesword, backstep, forwardstep, katanajump all bottom out at 0). The two severance deaths are the sharpest case: deathnohead is 23 frames of 17 nodes then 8 frames of exactly ONE node (i=16), deathnohand is 23 frames of 17 then 2 frames of 3, while deathinhalf holds 17 across all 28. So a node record is a PER-FRAME DELTA LIST, not a full skeleton pose, and a renderer that resets unlisted joints each frame will tear the corpse apart on the tail of every dismemberment clip.
